page: Microsoft Azure E2ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Edsv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes 48 KB L1d cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and a large 260 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided via a bundled 118 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is premium storage capable.

Performance benchmarks reveal strong single-core capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2155.0 and single-threaded gzip compression throughput reaching 31.37 GB/sec. However, multi-core performance is limited due to the single physical core configuration, as reflected in a weak Geekbench multi-core score of 2643.0 and a poor stress-ng multi-core CPU performance rating. Memory bandwidth also shows constraints, with read-only large block bandwidth at 21.49 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 14.29 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E2ds_v6 offers a high memory-to-core density and fast local NVMe storage, making it a resource-dense option for workloads requiring significant memory without needing high parallel processing power. This hardware profile is well-suited for memory-bound applications, small-scale database operations, caching layers, and lightweight text processing tasks.
